_comment: A new game and a new partner. The C holds none of these numbers: a key left out means that does not exist (counts as 0). money: the tamer's money at the start. startHour/startMinute: the game clock the game boots with and the empty save of a new slot holds. partnerBirth: the lifetime (game hours), discipline and happiness every partner starts with when it is born or reborn, the partner of a new game included (the Jijimon scene picks Agumon or Gabumon and the game gives it these). lives: the lives of a partner at its start. firstPartner: the lifetime (game hours) and age (days) in the empty save a new slot is created with, which is what Continue loads from a slot that was never saved over; the first save of a real game holds the running partner's. Patch 0143: starters are the partners the Jijimon scene can give, the first (Agumon) and the second (Gabumon) choice; startScript is the MAPHEAD section a new game runs once the scene and the movie are over (it puts the tamer on the first screen); firstPartner.exit and firstPartner.species are the exit and the partner type stored in the empty save of a new slot (species 114 is a placeholder the first real partner replaces); cardShopStart is the first six values of the card shop's script state in that save (the cards on offer on day one). Left in code: the conversation itself (the state machine of the Jijimon scene).
